LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3: Prohibitions in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prohibitions in Islam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What causes drug abuse?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living
2. explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living
• Model 2: explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living
2. Practise: explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Prohibitions in Islam.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What causes drug abuse?
2. What are the effects of drug abuse in the society?
3. What are the possible remedies for drug abuse?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the effects of drug abuse for healthy living
• explain remedies for drug abuse for a healthy and morally upright society

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
